Dedicated unit tests exist for the new file (TestCanonicalNormalForm, TestCanonicalRejects, idempotency, toolchain independence); `go test ./internal/fsm/run/ -cover` reports 100.0% of statements, satisfying the repo's coverage gate.
marshalCanonical cross-checked: SetEscapeHTML(false) leaves <>& literal, and it explicitly ReplaceAll-escapes U+2028, U+2029 and U+FFFD after compaction.

CapText budget verified against marshalCanonical for every class: 2 bytes for " \\ \n \r \t, 6 for C0 controls and U+2028/9, 6 forced for utf8.RuneError (both a raw invalid byte and a genuine U+FFFD encode to the six-byte escape), 1 for DEL and HTML characters since escaping is off. cut advances by DecodeRuneInString size, so the cut is always on a UTF-8 boundary.

OutputHash's documented empty-string-hash fallback checked against its only comparison site: Apply rejects a non-canonicalizable NodeOutputData at fold.go:113 and machine.go:980/1008 rejects it at record time, so the invalid/nil hash collision is never reachable in a comparison. NodeOutputData.Output is json.RawMessage, so stored bytes round-trip verbatim and the hash is stable.

findings.note: Stale doc contract on an exported function: internal/fsm/run/canonical.go:16 states the canonical form leaves "HTML characters and U+2028/U+2029 left as literal UTF-8", but only the HTML half is true. marshalCanonical (internal/fsm/run/types.go:351-352) escapes U+2028/U+2029 to \u2028/\u2029, and canonical_test.go:27 pins that escaped form as expected. Since Canonical's bytes feed OutputHash and are stored on the event log, a reader trusting the comment would mispredict hash-affecting output. No behavioral impact - the implementation and tests agree with each other, only the comment is wrong.

CapText reports truncation that did not occur for the empty string: internal/fsm/run/canonical.go:200-202 returns ("", true) whenever max < 2, without first checking s == "", even though "" encodes to exactly two bytes and nothing was cut. Currently unreachable - every caller passes MaxShort (1024) or larger, and kind.go:141 within() only forwards those constants - so this is latent rather than live, but the boolean is the truncated flag several call sites branch on (cmdexec.go:142, machine.go:284).
